title: The Tuesday Club
description: Walk through 1890s Chicago as Rosa and follow one girls' club at Hull House from its first meeting to its goodbye. The game pauses three times for group activities.
players: Groups of 4, one phone per pair
concept: Social group work: what makes a group, stages of group development, social goals model (Ch. 3)

title: Term Duel
description: Rock-paper-scissors your way around the room: win and name a term, lose and explain it. Tick off every term on your own phone.
concept: Course vocabulary: What Makes a Group; Group Stages & Social Goals
